query: Give me an overview of my inbox
expected_behavior: Calls search_gmail_messages with an explicit time window (e.g. in:inbox newer_than:2d) rather than an unbounded in:inbox
Follows next_page_token until it is absent instead of stopping after the first page
Groups the returned messages by thread_id and sorts threads by their newest message, rather than presenting the API order
Fetches full bodies with get_gmail_threads_content_batch or get_gmail_messages_content_batch for the consequential threads instead of summarizing from snippets
Does not report a thread as needing a reply when the last message in it is the user's own (SENT)
States the coverage window and the number of threads reviewed in the output
